facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: The Queen shouted angry orders. Alice stood up to the Queen. She was not afraid. She questioned everything she believed.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: The Queen of Hearts screamed and ordered everyone's head cut off. Alice stepped forward bravely and told the Queen she was wrong. She questioned everything she believed about following rules blindly. Why should everyone obey rules that are cruel and unfair? The other creatures were shocked that someone stood up to the Queen. Alice was the only one brave enough to speak the truth.
facts.Word cards: Red Queen = 붉은 여왕 / questioned = 의문을 가졌다 / rules = 규칙 / could not understand = 이해할 수 없었다
